mapper.select: WITH current_documents AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.file_id, d.document_type) d.id, d.file_id, d.document_type FROM documents d JOIN files f ON f.id = d.file_id WHERE f.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND f.is_dir = false AND d.source_revision = f.revision ORDER BY d.file_id, d.document_type, d.updated_at DESC, d.id DESC ), chunk_stats AS ( SELECT cd.file_id, COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE cd.document_type = 'text')::int AS text_chunk_count, COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE cd.document_type = 'vision')::int AS vision_chunk_count, COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE cd.document_type = 'text' AND c.embedding IS NOT NULL AND #{fingerprint, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND c.embedding_fingerprint = #{fingerprint, jdbcType=VARCHAR})::int AS text_current_vector_chunks, COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE cd.document_type = 'vision' AND c.embedding IS NOT NULL AND #{fingerprint, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND c.embedding_fingerprint = #{fingerprint, jdbcType=VARCHAR})::int AS vision_current_vector_chunks, COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE cd.document_type = 'text' AND c.embedding IS NOT NULL AND (#{fingerprint, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR c.embedding_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM #{fingerprint, jdbcType=VARCHAR}))::int AS text_stale_vector_chunks, COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE cd.document_type = 'vision' AND c.embedding IS NOT NULL AND (#{fingerprint, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR c.embedding_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM #{fingerprint, jdbcType=VARCHAR}))::int AS vision_stale_vector_chunks FROM current_documents cd LEFT JOIN document_chunks c ON c.document_id = cd.id AND c.source_revision = ( SELECT f.revision FROM files f WHERE f.id = cd.file_id ) GROUP BY cd.file_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.is_dir = false)::int AS eligible_files, COUNT(cs.file_id)::int AS extracted_files, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE f.is_dir = false AND COALESCE(cs.text_chunk_count, 0) > 0 AND cs.text_current_vector_chunks = cs.text_chunk_count )::int AS text_vector_files, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE f.is_dir = false AND COALESCE(cs.vision_chunk_count, 0) > 0 AND cs.vision_current_vector_chunks = cs.vision_chunk_count )::int AS vision_vector_files, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE f.is_dir = false AND cs.file_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(cs.text_chunk_count, 0) + COALESCE(cs.vision_chunk_count, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(cs.text_current_vector_chunks, 0) + COALESCE(cs.vision_current_vector_chunks, 0) = COALESCE(cs.text_chunk_count, 0) + COALESCE(cs.vision_chunk_count, 0) )::int AS vector_files, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE f.is_dir = false AND cs.file_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(cs.text_chunk_count, 0) + COALESCE(cs.vision_chunk_count, 0) = 0 )::int AS non_vectorizable_files, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE f.is_dir = false AND cs.file_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(cs.text_chunk_count, 0) + COALESCE(cs.vision_chunk_count, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(cs.text_current_vector_chunks, 0) + COALESCE(cs.vision_current_vector_chunks, 0) < COALESCE(cs.text_chunk_count, 0) + COALESCE(cs.vision_chunk_count, 0) )::int AS missing_vectors, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE f.is_dir = false AND COALESCE(cs.text_stale_vector_chunks, 0) + COALESCE(cs.vision_stale_vector_chunks, 0) > 0 )::int AS stale_vectors, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE f.is_dir = false AND COALESCE(cs.text_chunk_count, 0) > 0 AND cs.text_current_vector_chunks < cs.text_chunk_count )::int AS text_missing_vectors, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE f.is_dir = false AND COALESCE(cs.vision_chunk_count, 0) > 0 AND cs.vision_current_vector_chunks < cs.vision_chunk_count )::int AS vision_missing_vectors FROM files f LEFT JOIN chunk_stats cs ON cs.file_id = f.id WHERE f.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)

SELECT id::text AS id, path, is_dir, size_bytes, revision, content_md5, content_sha256, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM updated_at) AS mtime FROM files WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND path = #{path, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND is_dir = false

SELECT id::text AS id, path, is_dir, size_bytes, revision, content_md5, content_sha256 FROM files WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND is_dir = false AND (#{prefix, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR path = #{prefix, jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR path LIKE CONCAT(#{escapedPrefix, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '/%') ESCAPE CHR(92)) ORDER BY path ASC

SELECT id::text AS id, path, is_dir, size_bytes, revision, content_md5, content_sha256 FROM files WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND is_dir = false AND (#{prefix, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR path = #{prefix, jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR path LIKE CONCAT(#{escapedPrefix, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '/%') ESCAPE CHR(92)) ORDER BY path ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT f.id::text AS id, f.path, f.is_dir, f.size_bytes, f.revision, CASE WHEN #{kind, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'document' THEN 'document' ELSE 'vector' END AS missing_kind, #{documentType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS document_type FROM files f WHERE f.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND f.is_dir = false AND (#{prefix, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR f.path = #{prefix, jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR f.path LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '/%'))
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM documents d WHERE d.file_id = f.id AND d.source_revision = f.revision AND (#{documentType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR d.document_type = #{documentType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM documents d JOIN document_chunks c ON c.document_id = d.id WHERE d.file_id = f.id AND d.source_revision = f.revision AND c.source_revision = f.revision AND (#{documentType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR d.document_type = #{documentType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (#{fingerprint, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR c.embedding IS NULL OR c.embedding_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM #{fingerprint, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) )
ORDER BY f.path ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

INSERT INTO documents(file_id, source_revision, document_type, extractor_version, content) SELECT f.id, #{sourceRevision}, #{documentType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{extractorVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} FROM files f WHERE f.id = CAST(#{fileId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND f.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) ON CONFLICT (file_id, source_revision, document_type, extractor_version) DO UPDATE SET content = EXCLUDED.content, updated_at = now() RETURNING id::text AS id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM document_chunks WHERE document_id = CAST(#{documentId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)

DELETE FROM documents d USING files f WHERE d.file_id = f.id AND f.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND d.file_id = CAST(#{fileId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND d.document_type = #{documentType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND (d.source_revision <> #{sourceRevision} OR d.extractor_version <> #{extractorVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_chunks(document_id, chunk_index, source_revision, chunk_version, content) VALUES (CAST(#{documentId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{chunkIndex}, #{sourceRevision}, #{chunkVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}) ON CONFLICT (document_id, chunk_index, chunk_version) DO UPDATE SET source_revision = EXCLUDED.source_revision, content = EXCLUDED.content, embedding = NULL, embedding_fingerprint = NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM documents d USING files f WHERE d.file_id = f.id AND f.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND d.source_revision <> f.revision
mapper.update: UPDATE document_chunks c SET embedding = NULL, embedding_fingerprint = NULL FROM documents d JOIN files f ON f.id = d.file_id WHERE c.document_id = d.id AND f.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)

UPDATE document_chunks c SET embedding = CAST(#{vector, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} AS vector), embedding_fingerprint = #{fingerprint, jdbcType=VARCHAR} FROM documents d JOIN files f ON f.id = d.file_id WHERE c.id = CAST(#{chunkId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND c.document_id = d.id AND d.source_revision = f.revision AND c.source_revision = d.source_revision AND f.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)
